info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Event Subscriptions API
info.description: The Manage Event Subscriptions API allows users to update and manage their event subscriptions within the Open Banking framework. This endpoint enables businesses to modify existing subscriptions based on specific parameters, facilitating real-time access to relevant financial events. Typical consumers include developers integrating banking services into their applications, as well as financial institutions looking to enhance user engagement through tailored notifications. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their subscription management processes and create responsive systems to meet customer needs.

put.description: Allows the modification of the details of an existing event subscription identified by its unique resource ID. Provide the necessary data in the request body to update the subscription parameters.
